objective: Show that the six non-symmetric knots excluding three tuples form one orbit under place permutations and complement, that each is the Fibonacci knot with negated legs, so their native networks are Fibonacci networks with twisted (disequality) edges and complemented pins; that in the Fibonacci eigenbasis a twist is a reflection with a negative entry, making the count a signed two-spin sum; and that McQuillan's winding, the Fibonacci holographic algorithm and weighted Fibonacci gates each fail on them for an identified reason.
status: Proved by NATIVE-APPROX-20261024-001B-P001 (V1 prose proof with standard-library check). The six open knots are one orbit, each the Fibonacci knot with one or two negated places, so their native networks are Fibonacci networks with twisted (disequality) edges; in the Fibonacci basis a twist is a reflection with one negative entry, making the count a signed two-spin sum, which is why winding, the Fibonacci holographic algorithm and weighted Fibonacci gates all stop there.
title: The open knots are twisted Fibonacci knots
